meta.description: Agent-safe API and bounded Midjourney browser image generation for content creation workflows.
meta.author: brandonz@heritagehill.co
meta.boundary: Canonical image-generation stack. Midjourney support is limited to dedicated-profile login, idempotent prompt submission, authenticated session checks, and requester-triggered export of job variations. No arbitrary navigation, selectors, likes, follows, deletes, edits, uploads, billing, or account management.
meta.mcpSafety: Midjourney browser state remains in a dedicated local RUDI profile and is never returned over MCP. Generation requires a caller-provided request_id; ambiguous prior submissions fail closed. Job IDs and variation indexes are validated, UI controls are exact and fail closed on drift, and downloaded image files are size-, signature-, digest-, source-, and output-boundary-validated.
